items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: Then I had to go back to join Norman in Detroit to play a couple of one-night gigs with him for the Jazz at the Philharmonic.

ctx.x: So when the two of you were in Chicago, it was the two of you with a local...

Yeah, with a local rhythm section. That was in '47. Because we got... He came on back to New York City, and I came to New York, too, but I came and hung out with Fats. Then I had to go back to join Norman in Detroit to play a couple of one-night gigs with him for the Jazz at the Philharmonic.
Now, let's dovetail back a little bit. You had been doing Jazz at the Philharmonics from the time you were in California.
